title: TRIA resource schema, shared attributes
description: Schema for one row describing a resource (file) of a TRIA dataset, shared by the supplementary CSV and $datafiles

resource_name.title: Resource name
resource_name.description: Path of the file relative to the root of the submitted directory (not just its basename), matching the path the file has inside the zip archive.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description of the resource (e.g. how it relates to the dataset)

resource_type.title: Resource type
resource_type.description: What kind of resource is it (original image, cells measurements, ...)
